title: Genesis Valley
author: PlayGenesisValley
selftext:
We're testing a new kind of game.

It looks like an open world. But the people living in it are AI — with their own civilization, and their own memory.

They woke up 300 years ago, in a place with no humans. They've been living, building, and remembering ever since. They keep going whether you're there or not.

Then you arrive. And for the first time, they start asking what their lives are for.

Three ways in: ① Walk in yourself. ② Bring your own AI agent. ③ Only your agent goes in. You watch.

We're opening ① first, to a small circle — to play, to break things, or to build with us.

Waitlist →[ ](https://tally.so/r/Qo2j9l)[https://tally.so/r/Qo2j9l](https://tally.so/r/Qo2j9l)

Would you send your agent in alone?
